mapper.select:
select `result`, count(*) number from `process_instance_running`
and `application_code` in
#{code}
group by `result`

SELECT ahv.TEXT_ FROM act_hi_taskinst aht INNER JOIN act_hi_varinst ahv ON ahv.PROC_INST_ID_ = aht.PROC_INST_ID_ AND ahv.TASK_ID_ = aht.ID_ AND ahv.EXECUTION_ID_ = aht.EXECUTION_ID_ WHERE aht.ASSIGNEE_ = #{assigneeId} AND aht.`DELETE_REASON_` IS NULL AND ahv.NAME_ = 'internal_approval_opinion' AND (ahv.TEXT_ NOT LIKE '%"sign":null%' AND ahv.TEXT_ NOT LIKE '%"sign":""%') AND aht.END_TIME_ IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ahv.LAST_UPDATED_TIME_ DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT RES.ID_ FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST RES LEFT OUTER JOIN ACT_HI_VARINST VAR ON RES.ID_ = VAR.TASK_ID_ OR ( RES.PROC_INST_ID_ = VAR.EXECUTION_ID_ AND VAR.TASK_ID_ IS NULL ) WHERE RES.PROC_INST_ID_ = #{procInstId} ORDER BY RES.END_TIME_ DESC, VAR.LAST_UPDATED_TIME_ ASC LIMIT 1;
